learningGoals: Read and write numbers up to 100 with confidence. ✍️
Understand the basic concept of tens and ones. 🔟
Sequence numbers from smallest to largest and vice versa. 📈
Identify and complete simple number patterns. 🧠
teachingTips: Count steps aloud while walking up or down the stairs together. 🚶‍♂️
Group household items like crayons or matchsticks into bundles of ten to explain 'Tens and Ones'. 🖍️
Ask your child to read numbers on car license plates, house doors, or digital clocks. 🚗
Play classic board games like Snakes and Ladders to naturally reinforce counting and number recognition. 🐍

funActivities.title: Bundle of Tens 🥢
funActivities.description: Give your child a large set of straws or crayons and ask them to tie them into bundles of 10 using rubber bands.

funActivities.title: Number Line Jump 🦘
funActivities.description: Draw a number line on the floor with chalk and call out a number for your child to jump to.

funActivities.title: Mystery Number ❓
funActivities.description: Give simple hints like 'I am more than 10 and less than 12. Who am I?' to build number logic.
